title: F7N per-acoustic-substep touchdown-column WRF-vs-JAX diff (Straka em_grav2d_x)

touchdown_column.note: WRF i=256=nxc=domain center; JAX center mass index nearest x=0

field_convention: u_iface/u_ip1face/w/ww are the COUPLED small-step work arrays (mu*field); dudx is the coupled mass-flux horizontal divergence (u_ip1face-u_iface)/dx, exactly the term advance_mu_t integrates into dmdt and ww.
post_fix_status: POST-FIX (vertical-momentum-advection sign corrected + conservative const-K diffusion). JAX center-column ww low-level stays bounded (~0) matching WRF; the pre-fix runaway (ww low to -68/-165, coupled w_min to -2.4e6) is gone. Coupled w_min ~-3000 runs larger-magnitude than WRF ~-1000..-2500 due to (a) half-cell grid registration (WRF bubble center on mass point i=256; JAX center on a cell face) and (b) vertical grid (JAX 60 uniform 100m vs WRF 65 stretched); both bounded, and the operational physics gate max|w|@900s=14.57 matches WRF ~14-15.
pre_fix_reference: See git history / touchdown_fix.md for the pre-fix table: ww low-level -68/-165, coupled w_min -2.4e6, max|u| 16->523 m/s, front frozen 2350-2450 m -> NaN ~205 s.
